title: Toddler Girl Planting Sapling Tree in Backyard, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot depicting a young toddler girl crouching near a newly planted sapling tree in a backyard lawn. She holds a stick or small garden tool pointing toward the fresh dirt around the base of the sapling. A wooden fence and a clothesline are visible in the background, representing quintessential post-WWII suburban life in mid-20th century America.
